## Symlink & GNU Stow Readiness

- [ ] CHK001 All configuration paths follow standard modular structure (`[module]/.config/[app]`)
- [ ] CHK002 GNU Stow dry-run (`stow -n -v [module]`) executes with zero target conflicts
- [ ] CHK003 No hardcoded absolute home directory paths (use `$HOME` or relative paths)

## Package & Installer Coherence

- [ ] CHK004 Required system packages are registered in `packages.json` (or distro package manifest)
- [ ] CHK005 Setup routines in installer script are strictly idempotent
- [ ] CHK006 Privileged operations (/etc, system hooks) are separated from user stow configs

## Security & Repository Hygiene

- [ ] CHK007 No private keys, SSH tokens, passwords, or secrets exist in config files
- [ ] CHK008 Temporary files, build caches, and logs are matched by `.dotfilesignore`
- [ ] CHK009 Large binary assets (.7z, iso, binaries) are managed cleanly (or LFS/external download)
